sections.label: Nine days of debate
sections.summary: The sitting covered close to 70 hours of debate in nine days, with 61 Members speaking on the Budget Statement and 598 cuts covered.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Under your efficient management, we covered much ground in nine days – close to 70 hours of debate.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Sixty-one Members spoke for two and a half days in the debate on the Budget Statement and we covered 598 cuts over seven days of Committee of Supply.

sections.label: Enhanced Assurance Package support
sections.summary: The enhanced Assurance Package provides CDC Vouchers, a Cost-of-Living Special Payment and U-Save and S&CC rebates to assure Singaporeans on cost-of-living concerns.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The enhanced Assurance Package – which includes additional Community Development Council (CDC) Vouchers for all Singaporean households, a Cost-of-Living Special Payment in cash for eligible adult Singaporeans and additional U-Save and service and conservancy charges (S&CC) rebates for eligible HDB households – provides assurance to Singaporeans for cost-of-living concerns.

sections.label: Enterprise and SkillsFuture support
sections.summary: The $1.3 billion Enterprise Support Package includes a Corporate Income Tax Rebate and enhanced schemes, while Budget 2024 SkillsFuture measures express confidence in workers.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Beyond this, we have strengthened support for our companies with the $1.3 billion Enterprise Support Package, which includes a generous Corporate Income Tax Rebate, as well as enhanced schemes that support collaborations and partnerships between local and multinational enterprises, scaling up of our firms and sustainability.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: With the SkillsFuture measures in Budget 2024, we have expressed our belief and confidence in our workers, as well as our confidence in their ability not only to upskill but to chart new directions even at a later age.

sections.label: ITE award and worker wages
sections.summary: The new ITE Progression Award expresses commitment to social mobility, and Workfare Income Supplement and Progressive Wage Credit scheme enhancements uplift lower-wage workers.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Likewise, the new Institute of Technical Education (ITE) Progression Award is an expression of our commitment to social mobility as well as our confidence and belief in our ITE graduates.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We have continued to uplift our lower-wage workers and improve wages across different professions, through the enhancements to the Workfare Income Supplement scheme and the Progressive Wage Credit scheme.

sections.label: Support for parents and families
sections.summary: The Budget increases support for parents through lower childcare fee caps, enhanced preschool subsidies, more Build-To-Order supply and PPHS flats and vouchers.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In this Budget, we have increased support for parents.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We are improving preschool affordability by reducing monthly childcare fee caps in Government-supported preschools and enhancing preschool subsidies for lower-income families.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: To support married couples and young families, we have ramped up the Build-To-Oder supply, given them greater priority, increased the number of Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme (PPHS) flats and will provide the PPHS (Open Market) Voucher.

sections.label: Climate change and Future Energy Fund
sections.summary: Concrete steps towards net-zero emissions by 2050 include setting up the Future Energy Fund with an initial $5 billion injection.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As the threat of climate change looms ever larger for the world and for Singapore, we have taken concrete steps towards achieving our ambitious climate target of net-zero emissions by 2050, including setting up the Future Energy Fund this year with an initial injection of $5 billion to help decarbonise our energy system and enhance our security in clean energy.

sections.label: Spending over $130 billion
sections.summary: The speaker calls spending over $130 billion a serious business and thanks Members for their time, energy and ideas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: For me, spending over $130 billion is a serious business, and I thank hon Members for your time, your energy and your ideas.

sections.label: Budget debate participation statistics
sections.summary: 61 Members spoke in this year's Budget debate versus 58 last year, and 598 cuts were filed versus 661 last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: In all, some 61 Members from both front and back bench spoke this year in the Budget debate, compared to 58 Members last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Some more statistics: there were 598 cuts filed this year for the Committee of Supply, compared to 661 cuts last year.

sections.label: Total fertility rate below 1.00
sections.summary: The total fertility rate has gone below 1.00 for the very first time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: For the very first time, our total fertility rate (TFR) unfortunately, has gone below 1.00.
